claim: About one message in ten crosses its counterpart, mostly on routes through the master.

metric.what: Pairs on the same route in opposite directions where the second was written before the first was read.

countedFrom.machine: one Windows 11 machine; one master, 8 orchestrators, about 50 short-lived workers, one person
versions: agent harness as installed in the period (exact version not recorded)

proposedChange: Follows from G2 and G3: fewer hops and batched replies. Measure again after those.
whyItGeneralises: Crossed messages follow from latency and hop count in any asynchronous messaging; fewer hops reduce them anywhere.
